For a 4-night business stay, these are three sensible offers to shortlist. Exact totals depend on dates/occupancy, so verify the final checkout price.

Crowne Plaza Gurgaon, an IHG Hotel — ~₹6,600/night indicative. Breakfast packages available; Wi-Fi. Check for a fully refundable rate and cancellation deadline. 
ixigo

Hyatt Place Gurgaon Udyog Vihar — ~₹5,900/night indicative. Business-friendly Udyog Vihar location; breakfast-inclusive rates and Wi-Fi worth checking. Confirm whether cancellation is free and until when.

Holiday Inn Gurugram Sector 90 by IHG — ~₹3,300/night indicative. Current listings show breakfast + Wi-Fi + free cancellation on some rates, with no prepayment. 
Booking.com

Before paying: verify the 4-night all-in GST total, breakfast for every guest/day, Wi-Fi inclusion, cancellation deadline, and whether the refund goes back to the original payment method.
